title: PromptAction - Data API
description: Represents how the user interacted with the in-app guidance prompt or walkthrough. Available in API version 46.0 and later.

LastDisplayDate.description: Indicates the date the in-app guidance was last displayed to the user.

LastResult.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
LastResult.description: Indicates the last user interaction. Valid values are: CustomAction Dismiss Error Finish—(walkthroughs only) NoAction NotSeen Snooze

LastResultDate.description: Indicates the date the in-app guidance was last interacted with.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the owner. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

PromptVersionId.description: ID of the PromptVersion object. This is a relationship field.

SnoozeUntil.description: The timestamp for when the user’s snooze request expires. The user won’t see the prompt again until they navigate to the page after the snooze time expires.

StepCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StepCount.description: Indicates the total number of steps in the walkthrough. Available in API version 49.0 and later.

StepNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StepNumber.description: Indicates the number of the last step the user viewed or interacted with in a walkthrough. Maximum value is 10. Available in API version 49.0 and later.

TimesActionTaken.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TimesActionTaken.description: Number of times that the user took action on the in-app guidance.

TimesDismissed.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TimesDismissed.description: Number of times that the user dismissed the in-app guidance.

TimesDisplayed.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TimesDisplayed.description: Number of times that the in-app guidance was displayed to the user.

TimesSnoozed.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TimesSnoozed.description: The total number of times the user snoozes the prompt.

UserId.description: ID of the user. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To add, edit, manage, and view prompts and walkthroughs in Lightning Experience or in Experience Cloud sites, multiple permissions are required. See Permissions for Creating and Accessing In-App Guidance in Salesforce Help.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. They are available in API version 46.0 and later.

- **PromptActionOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **PromptActionShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
